verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. All five conjuncts are present; the only rewriting is the clearing of k in the phase split. (i) k = ⌈ε^{-1/2}⌉ is `carrierFrequency` verbatim (ℕ-ceiling of ε^{-1/2}), and it is the frequency the construction uses: `(chartCoefficients …).frequency n` reduces to `(ChartScales.carrier ActualPrimary.h n : ℝ)` = `Scaling.carrierFrequency (epsilon h n)` (ActualPhaseJetBounds.lean:632-633, ChartScales.lean:244). (ii) The phase split is stated in cleared form: `phase_split` gives k·Φ(x,θ) = k·φ(x) + m·θ with m = `angularMode` : ℤ, which is the paper's Φ = p_γ θ + φ_γ with p_γ = m/k (k > 0, so dividing by k is the whole rewriting); `AffinePhase` is the same condition in translation-integrated form. (iii) `angularMode_ne_zero` is k p_γ ∈ ℤ \ {0}. (iv) Finiteness of ℋ_j and ℋ_j ⊂ ℤ \ {0} are structural rather than stated as a set condition: `Coefficients` is an `AddMonoidAlgebra … ℤ`, whose elements have finite support, and the zero mode is excluded per label (`angularMode_ne_zero`) and by the `j ≠ 0` guard in `HarmonicSourceSupport.NonzeroSupportedOn`. (v) 0 < P_v ≤ 1 (0 ≤ v ≤ L_s) is stated exactly, for the construction's own envelope: `pulseEnvelope l = referenceP (lam) (u) (L)`, `referenceP_pos` gives 0 < referenceP unconditionally, and `referenceP_le_one` gives referenceP ≤ 1 under 0 < lam, u, L and t ∈ Icc 0 L — the paper's own range restriction. `envelope_le_one` discharges those four hypotheses in the actual construction (lam_pos, u_pos, L_pos, and v ∈ Icc 0 L from the clock-window core) for the copy-transported `envelope`, which equals `pulseEnvelope` on each copy cell by `envelope_copy` and is extended by zero off the cells — which is why `envelope_nonneg` (line 185) proves only 0 ≤ there. Strict positivity is also carried as the hypothesis field `envelope_pos : ∀ n v, 0 < W n v` of `CopyControl`, discharged by `referenceP_pos` (ScaledActualParticularControl.lean:198, ActualParticularControl.lean:653).
